title: D2 Action Interpreter v0.1
description: Player intent only. No world facts, resolution or mutation authority.

action.description: Concise description of what the player is attempting, never an outcome.

target.description: Explicit action object as mentioned by the player; not a resolved entity or verified ownership.

destination.description: Explicitly named or described travel destination, without existence validation or entity IDs.

direction.description: Open exploration direction, only when there is no explicit destination.

intent.description: Purpose explicitly expressed by the player, not an achieved result.

method.description: Explicitly stated action method, otherwise null.

goal.description: Long-term goal explicitly established or cancelled by the player.

needs_clarification.description: True only for unresolved linguistic ambiguity, never world feasibility.
